# Vendored: Meterless H-MEM reference engine

Unmodified copy of `engines/hmem/reference/src` from
[github.com/Meterless/Meterless](https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless) at commit `1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd`.

- Licence: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this folder). Copyright belongs to its authors.
- `dist/` is generated by `pnpm hmem:build` (types removed, `.ts` imports → `.mjs`) so the
  packaged server runs it on plain Node; it is what Agent Town imports.
- Zero runtime dependencies. Agent Town uses it as the memory engine behind
  `lib/server/decision-memory.mjs` (verified supplier findings recalled by order number).
- Conformance: `pnpm hmem:conformance` (built engine) or `pnpm hmem:conformance source`; results in
  `docs/evidence/hmem-conformance.txt`.
- Do not edit these files; update them by re-copying from upstream.
